title: The 11 Best Coffee Grinders Under $200 in 2026
h1: The 11 Best Coffee Grinders Under $200 in 2026
metaDescription: Our 11 picks for coffee grinders under $200 in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at coffee grinders under $200 in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Baratza Encore Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: 40mm conical burrs, 40 settings, Filter optimized.
strengths: The most widely recommended starter burr grinder, proven over 15+ years
Baratza repair program makes it a 10-year investment, not a disposable grinder
40 settings cover drip, pour-over, and French press well
Produces dramatically more even extraction than any blade grinder
limitations: Cannot reach espresso-fine settings, upgrade to the Encore ESP for espresso
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Baratza Sette 270Wi Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: Grind-by-weight, Espresso and filter, Anti-static.
strengths: Grind-by-weight adjustment covers true espresso through coarse French press, one grinder for everything
Anti-static technology reduces mess at fine espresso settings
Compact body, one of the smallest all-purpose grinders with genuine espresso capability
limitations: Conical burrs, slightly less uniform than flat at espresso settings

products.name: Baratza Encore ESP Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: Espresso capable, 40mm conical, Simple.
strengths: The only Baratza grinder that reaches espresso-fine settings
Simple design minimizes variables, fewer settings means fewer mistakes
Baratza repair support and long-term serviceability
The minimum correct espresso grinder
limitations: Stepped adjustment, espresso fine-tuning requires dose adjustment between steps
Less precise than the Fellow Opus or Eureka Mignon at espresso settings

products.name: OXO Brew Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: 15 settings, One-touch timer, Clear hopper.
strengths: One-touch timer reduces dosing variables, correct for beginners
Clear hopper shows remaining beans at a glance
Simple cleaning, fewer parts to disassemble than Baratza alternatives
The most approachable grinder for households new to burr grinding

products.name: Timemore Chestnut C3 Manual Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: Manual, Stepless espresso, Steel burrs.
strengths: Produces more consistent grinds than most electric grinders at the same price
Espresso-capable stepless range, more versatile than the Baratza Encore
No power required, the correct choice for travel, offices, and camping
limitations: 30 to 60 seconds of hand grinding per dose
Requires a consistent hand pressure technique for repeatable shots

products.name: Breville Smart Grinder Pro BCG820BSS
products.blurb: Key specs: 60 settings, LCD display, Programmable timer.
strengths: 60 grind settings, the most settings of any grinder in this price range
Programmable dose-by-time LCD with memory settings
Portafilter cradle doses directly, correct for matched Breville espresso setups
limitations: Higher retention than Baratza, more stale grounds between doses
Grinding consistency at espresso settings is below the Baratza Encore ESP

products.name: Cuisinart DBM-8 Supreme Grind Burr Mill
products.blurb: Key specs: Burr mill, 18 settings, Large hopper.
strengths: The cheapest flat-burr-adjacent grinder for drip coffee, adequate for drip machines
Large hopper capacity for households that make many cups
limitations: Blade-adjacent grinding consistency, higher fines production than Baratza alternatives
Upgrade to the Baratza Encore if you care about cup quality
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: 1Zpresso K-Pro Manual Coffee Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: External adjustment, Espresso capable, Stainless.
strengths: External adjustment ring, change settings without disassembling the grinder
Full espresso-fine range with 48mm burrs
Produces grinds comparable to grinders 2x the price

products.name: Baratza Virtuoso+ Conical Burr Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: 40mm conical, DC motor, Timer.
strengths: DC motor is quieter and runs at more consistent speed than the Encore's AC motor
Built-in timer for consistent dose-by-time grinding
The correct next-level Baratza after the Encore, same support, better motor

products.name: Hario V60 Electric Coffee Grinder
products.blurb: Key specs: Ceramic burrs, Pour-over optimized, Simple.
strengths: Ceramic burrs optimized for filter coffee, clean extraction at medium-coarse settings
Quieter than most electric grinders at the same price
Correct for pour-over and drip households who want simple operation
limitations: Fewer settings than the Baratza Encore

products.name: Fellow Opus Conical Burr Coffee Grinder
strengths: 41 settings from espresso to cold brew
Anti-static technology reduces mess
Compact design
Easy-to-read dial
limitations: Espresso adjustment is coarse versus dedicated grinders

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
